Coding Agents Lunch & Learn Session 23: What’s New in Coding Agents?

Join us for Session 23 of the Coding Agents Lunch & Learn, our weekly community gathering for anyone interested in coding agents, agentic AI, AI-powered developer tools, and the rapidly evolving world of software development.

Grab your lunch, take a break from your day, and come hang out with other builders, researchers, developers, and AI enthusiasts as we explore what’s new in the world of coding agents.

Each week is a chance to learn something new, hear what others are building, share ideas, ask questions, and have an open conversation about the tools, technologies, and trends shaping the future of AI-powered software development.

Whether you’re actively building agents, experimenting with AI coding tools, researching the space, or just curious about what’s happening, this is a casual place to connect with the community, discover new ideas, and learn something along the way.

No matter where you are in your journey, bring your lunch, your questions, and your curiosity.

Come hang out, learn something new, and join the conversation!
